name: MakerBot Replicator 2 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; MakerBot Replicator 2 start G-code (OrcaX3G)
M136 ; start build
M73 P0
G21 ; millimeters
G90 ; absolute positioning
M82 ; absolute extrusion
G162 X Y F2500 ; home X and Y to max endstops
G161 Z F1100 ; home Z to min endstop
G92 Z-5 ; set Z offset for safe re-home
G1 Z0.0 F1100 ; move Z down slightly
G161 Z F100 ; slow precision Z home
M132 X Y Z A B ; recall calibrated home offsets from EEPROM
G1 X-112 Y-73 Z30 F3300 ; move to front-left waiting corner
G130 X118 Y118 Z40 A118 B118 ; set stepper digipots (Replicator 2 defaults)
T0 ; select single right extruder
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; set nozzle target temperature
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; wait for nozzle to reach temperature
G92 E0 ; reset logical extruder
G1 X-112 Y-73 Z0.3 F1500 ; drop to prime height
G1 X-60 Y-73 Z0.3 E8.0 F1200 ; prime purge line
G92 E0 ; reset logical extruder for print
machine_end_gcode:
; MakerBot Replicator 2 end G-code (OrcaX3G)
M73 P100
G92 E0
G1 E-1.3 F1500 ; short retract
M107 ; part cooling fan off
M104 S0 T0 ; extruder heater off
G1 Z150 F1100 ; lower build platform
G162 X Y F2500 ; park carriage at max endstops
M18 ; disable stepper motors
M72 P1 ; play Ta-Da song
M137 ; end build
